points.point: Why an edit via Claude created two posts
points.sentence: Two posts for what should have been an edit most likely means the AI tool also called blotato_create_post.

points.point: How to get Claude to edit the post without creating a new one
points.sentence: Tell it in so many words: use only blotato_update_schedule, and do not create a new post.

verdict.reason: The customer asked an AI tool to edit a scheduled post and got a duplicate, which is the exact case this entry explains, and it covers the LinkedIn post because it isn't platform-specific.
